title: YBVAutoRestart
description: A plugin for Paper that automatically restarts the server on a schedule and performs timer-based actions via the actions system.
body:
YBVAutoRestart
A plugin for Paper that automatically restarts the server on a schedule and executes timer-based actions through an actions system.

By default, text messages use MiniMessage. You can switch to legacy format if needed.

Features
Restart the server on a schedule.

Execute actions at specific seconds before a restart.

Display the status of the next restart.

Supports schedule, now, delay, stop, reload commands.

Commands
/ybvautorestart status
Shows when the next restart will occur.

/ybvautorestart reload
Reloads the configuration.

/ybvautorestart schedule <time>
Schedules a manual restart after a specified duration, e.g., 1h30m.

/ybvautorestart now
Triggers an immediate forced restart.

/ybvautorestart delay <seconds>
Delays an active restart.

/ybvautorestart stop
Cancels an active restart.
